claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission will carry four astronauts around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II mission is set to lift off on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed lunar mission since 1972.
Launch site for the Artemis II mission is NASA Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida, specifically Launch Pad 39B.
Launch date for the Artemis II mission is Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The launch window for the Artemis II mission opens at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission launch aims for a trajectory over the Atlantic Ocean.
The Artemis II mission will utilize the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission will utilize the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission journey is approximately 10 days.
